summary: Verified new copper 'Rating Ulang Otomatis' feature end-to-end. Backend: POST /api/copper/tests/{id}/rerate re-runs Gemini on the stored crop and updates classification/class_label/group/color/description/severity/status/confidence/ai_summary/recommendation. 404 on unknown id. Meaningful AI check passed: on batch CU-BATCH-20261008-356 sample #1 (orig class 1a, bright copper), manually re-crop to sample #3 bbox (dark 4a strip) then rerate → AI returned a darker class (severity strictly > 1), all AI fields refreshed and persisted on GET. Sample restored afterwards. Frontend: CropEditor copper-crop-autorate defaults to checked. Unchecking + copper-crop-save -> only PUT /crop fires, zero /rerate network calls, modal closes. Checked + save -> button label flips to 'AI MENILAI ULANG…' spinner, POST /rerate fires, toast 'AI menilai ulang sample #1: kelas 1a (CLEAR).' shown, modal closes, sample card gauge/class picker reflect the new class. Regression crop save/cancel still OK (used by Test 1 of the UI run and by existing test_copper_recrop.py which still passes 7/7 per iteration_15).
critical_code_review_comments: copper_rerate (server.py L2005): on AI exception returns 502 with friendly_ai_error — good. However it does NOT set `edited: True` on the record (only edited_at). If 'edited' is used in UI to badge human-edited records, pure AI-rerate shouldn't mark it; current behavior is consistent, but worth documenting.

copper_rerate always uses `crop_path or image_path`. If crop_path exists but file is missing in storage, _downscale fails and returns 404 'Image not found in storage'. Could fall back to image_path on get_object failure.

CropEditor.save: if recrop succeeds but rerate throws, modal still closes (toast errors shown). Users may want to retry rerate without re-cropping; expose a standalone 'Rate ulang' action on the card.
server.py still 4176 lines — modular split still outstanding (iteration_13/14/15 noted the same).
seed_data_creation: No new batches created. Reused existing CU-BATCH-20261008-356 (3 samples with bbox) from iteration_15. Pytest mutates sample #1 then restores original bbox + classification in finally block. Total AI calls this run: 1 rerate (backend meaningful test) + 1 rerate (frontend test) = 2.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rerate endpoint: POST /api/copper/tests/{id}/rerate (no body). Returns full CopperRecord with refreshed classification + AI fields. UI selectors added by this feature: copper-crop-autorate (checkbox inside CropEditor, defaults checked). Save button label switches to 'AI MENILAI ULANG…' while rerate.isPending. To re-exercise meaningful AI darkening without seeding a new batch, reuse CU-BATCH-20261008-356: swap sample 1's bbox to sample 3's bbox then rerate. Keep AI calls <=4 per run. Reusable pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_copper_rerate.py. Still-passing recrop pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_copper_recrop.py.
